claim: Looking for new dessert ideas. : r/thanksgiving - Reddit
summary: I'm looking for some new recipes for dessert. Every year I'll make about 7 from scratch. I rotate the selection each year. Pumpkin Chiffon pie, pumpkin cheesecake, various other cheesecakes, chocolate mousse pie, apple, lemon meringue, key lime, pecan, etc. If you have something you make and would like to share I would love to hear some fresh ideas. After 20 years I'm getting a little stale ...
